content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification provides 27 vacancies across various subjects and disciplines. Below is the complete breakdown as officially published.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Alternatively, the Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai). For the post of Assistant Professor – Sanskrit, Assistant Professor – Hindu Studies, and Assistant Professor – Indian Knowledge System (IKS) candidates are required to have proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking Sanskrit. content_sections.text: The posts carry the pay scale of Academic Level 10 Entry Pay of Rs. 57,700/- as per the 7th Pay. Minimum qualification and eligibility criteria for the posts will be as per UGC 2018 norms.

faq.question: Q1. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 27 total vacancies for Assistant Professor posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Online submission and Submission of printout of online application on or before Dt. 23/11/2026 till 17:00 Hrs. through Speed Post/ Courier only.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree with 55% marks in a concerned/relevant/allied subject along with NET, SLET, SET, or a Ph.D. Degree as per UGC Regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay scale for these posts?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor-Pay Scale-As per The 7th Pay (Rs.) – Academic Level 10 Entry Pay of Rs.57700/-.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: The notice mentions application fees and directs candidates to visit the university website: www.baou.edu.in for details.

faq.question: Q6. How should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Online submission and Submission of printout of online application on or before Dt. 23/11/2026 till 17:00 Hrs. through Speed Post/ Courier only.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The Academic score as specified in Appendix II (Table 3A) for Universities, and Appendix II (Table 3B) for Colleges, shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Are there specific language proficiencies required for certain posts?
faq.answer: For the post of Assistant Professor – Sanskrit, Assistant Professor – Hindu Studies, and Assistant Professor – Indian Knowledge System (IKS) Candidates are required to have proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking Sanskrit.

faq.question: Q9. Where can candidates find detailed instructions and the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates are requested to do visit university website: www.baou.edu.in for all details.
